load_inference_model_from_checkpoint: load a PyTorch inference model from a checkpoint file with optional EMA weights and config overrides
load_tasks_from_checkpoint: load and instantiate Task objects from a checkpoint file's tasks_config using Hydra
get_backbone_class_from_checkpoint: extract the backbone model class from a checkpoint's model config via the registry
update_configs_deep_merge: deep merge new config values into an original config dict or DictConfig recursively
enable_tf32_precision_context: use a context manager to temporarily enable TF32 matmul and cuDNN precision on CUDA
